title: Cheat Sledge

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Cheat Sledge is a club that is only available with console commands. Its appearance is identical to the Iron sledge.
The primary attack slams the ground (after a lengthy swing delay), dealing damage in a spherical AOE attack with a 20 meter radius, being able to clear out almost anything within that radius. It has no secondary attack.
It deals massive damage to all creatures, rocks and trees.
The Cheat sledge also has a movement speed effect of -20% while holding, a 2x backstab bonus, and a 2x parry bonus.
Like the Cheat Sword, it has a glowing rainbow aura, but unlike the sword, its aura only appears when its on the ground and it doesn't glow while equipped. Also unlike the Cheat Sword, it has a durability level and eventually breaks from use. It cannot be repaired by any crafting station.
